name: @nazar/contracts
description: TypeScript view of the NAZAR contracts, generated from the Pydantic models

scripts.contracts:generate: uv run python scripts/export_schema.py && node scripts/generate-ts.mjs
scripts.contracts:check: uv run python scripts/export_schema.py --check && node scripts/generate-ts.mjs --check
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && uv run mypy python tests scripts
